mapper.select: SELECT fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS prodId, val.VALUATION AS netValue, DATE_FORMAT(val.PUBLISH_DATE,'%Y%m%d') AS netValueDate, DATE_FORMAT(val.VAL_DATE,'%Y%m%d') AS effectDate, val.TOTAL_VALUE AS totalNetValue, val.YEAR_YIELD AS yearYield, val.DAY7_YEAR_YIELD AS sevenDaysYield, pafin.DEAL_MODE AS productType, CASE WHEN pafin.DEAL_MODE = '08' THEN val.VALUATION ELSE null END AS unitIncome, NULL AS yieldStTime, NULL AS yieldEdTime, finadd.INVEST_NATURE AS incomeType FROM FIN_PRODUCT fin left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD finadd on fin.FINPROD_ID = finadd.FINPROD_ID left join PA_FIN_PRODUCT pafin on fin.FINPROD_ID = pafin.FINPROD_ID join FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION val on fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = val.finprod_id AND fin.FINPROD_TYPE2 = val.FINPROD_TYPE2 WHERE fin.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{prodType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fin.FINPROD_ID = #{finProdId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND DATE_FORMAT(val.VAL_DATE,'%Y%m%d') = #{cdate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT CONCAT(IFNULL(lay.TERM_MIN ,'') , ',' , IFNULL( lay.TERM_MAX,'')) AS holdDaysInterval, CONCAT(IFNULL(lay.AMT_MIN ,'') , ',' , IFNULL(lay.AMT_MAX ,'')) AS buyAmtInterval, CONCAT(IFNULL( lay.CUSTOM_LEVEL,'') , ',' , IFNULL( lay.CUSTOM_LEVEL,'')) AS clientLvlInterval, lay.YIELD AS levelYield, CASE WHEN calc.BASIS = 'A/360' THEN '360' ELSE '365' END AS yearInterestDay FROM FIN_PRODUCT fin, PRD_LAYER_PARAM lay, FIN_CASH_INFO info, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE calc WHERE fin.FINPROD_ID = lay.FINPROD_ID AND fin.FINPROD_ID = info.FINPROD_ID AND fin.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{prodType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fin.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finProdId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND info.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND info.CASH_ID = calc.CASH_ID AND DATE_FORMAT(calc.EFF_DATE, '%Y%m%d') = #{cdate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT '1,9999' AS holdDaysInterval, '1,999999999' AS buyAmtInterval, '0,9' AS clientLvlInterval, calc.YIELD AS levelYield, CASE WHEN calc.BASIS = 'A/360' THEN '360' ELSE '365' END AS yearInterestDay FROM FIN_PRODUCT fin left join FIN_CASH_INFO info on fin.FINPROD_ID = info.FINPROD_ID join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE calc on info.CASH_ID = calc.CASH_ID WHERE fin.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{prodType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fin.FINPROD_ID = #{finProdId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND info.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND DATE_FORMAT(calc.EFF_DATE, '%Y%m%d') = #{cdate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
